name: magnet
title: Magnet
description: A field of small dots. The pointer is a magnet: the twenty-five nearest dots leave their cells and snap together into one solid block under it, then spring back out when it moves on or leaves.
docs: One self-contained file, react only: no Tailwind, no other dependency. Mount <Magnet /> inside an element with position: relative and a size; it covers that element and is decoration only: give it no link or click handler. Suggested commit: feat: add Magnet hover texture (textures.dev/s/magnet)
